_comment: Acceptance targets (challenge text, docs/PLAN.md). Source positions only: the pipeline converts and propagates them; no derived numbers are typed in here. SIMBAD values are ICRS, epoch J2000, read 2026-11-08 via simbad.cfa.harvard.edu and recorded in the prep repo's learning-log.md. pm_ra_cosdec is mu_alpha*cos(dec).
_comment_demo: m42, m16 and m31 (added 2026-11-15, T41) are demo targets, not challenge targets: famous extended objects, cached so a demo never waits for the archive. Positions are the SIMBAD object positions (ICRS J2000 degrees, read 2026-11-15 from simbad.cfa.harvard.edu TAP; they are the centre of the object, not a point source, and no proper motion is applied). They are built with stack_images 80 so the visit stacks have something to combine.
